service.advanced.changedOutside: advanced.json was changed outside Hive meanwhile: Settings shows it now. Try again.
service.advanced.fixFirst: {problem} Fix advanced.json (Settings → Advanced → Open advanced.json) before changing settings here.
service.advanced.fixOrDelete: {problem} Fix or delete advanced.json first (Settings → Advanced → Open advanced.json).
service.advanced.newer: advanced.json is from a newer Hive (format {format}): this one reads format {supported}.
service.advanced.notValues: advanced.json's "values" should be an object of setting → value.
service.attachments.badRecord: {file} is not a record of moved files
service.attachments.notOwn: {folder} is a link or not a folder of the project's own, so Hive keeps no attachments in it.
service.benchmarks.allPinned: {n} are kept and all are pinned: unpin or remove one first.
service.benchmarks.cantRead: The kept comparisons can’t be read: {error}
service.benchmarks.closed: The workspace was closed or switched: nothing was changed.
service.benchmarks.damaged: That comparison file is missing or damaged: remove it and import it again.
service.benchmarks.evictedStays: An evicted comparison couldn’t be removed yet: Hive will try again.
service.benchmarks.fileGone: A kept comparison’s file was gone: it was taken off the list.
service.benchmarks.invalid: {n, plural, one {# file that couldn’t be read was moved to quarantine/.} other {# files that couldn’t be read were moved to quarantine/.}}
service.benchmarks.noSuchHere: No such comparison for this scope
service.benchmarks.notRemoved: It is off the list, but its file couldn’t be removed yet: Hive will try again.
service.benchmarks.notWaiting: That file is no longer waiting: import it again.
service.benchmarks.overflow: {n, plural, one {# more than can be listed was moved to quarantine/.} other {# more than can be listed were moved to quarantine/.}}
service.benchmarks.recovered: Recovered: {reason}. {n, plural, one {# kept comparison is} other {# kept comparisons are}} listed again{setAside, select, yes {; the old list is kept as index.damaged-….json} other {}}
service.benchmarks.strays: {n, plural, one {# file not in the list was moved to quarantine/.} other {# files not in the list were moved to quarantine/.}}
service.benchmarks.stuck: {n, plural, one {# removed comparison’s file couldn’t be deleted yet (in use?): nothing more can be kept until it is.} other {# removed comparisons’ files couldn’t be deleted yet (in use?): nothing more can be kept until they are.}} Hive retries each time it reads the list.
service.benchmarks.switched: The workspace was switched: nothing was kept.
service.benchmarks.unwritable: Hive refused to write a list of kept comparisons it couldn’t read back: nothing was changed.
service.benchmarks.why: {why, select, missing {the list of kept comparisons was missing} damaged {the list of kept comparisons was damaged} entry {an entry of the list of kept comparisons was damaged} other {the list of kept comparisons had too many entries}}
service.benchmarks.wrongScope: That comparison file doesn’t match its scope: remove it and import it again.

service.files.groupInUse: Another program has one of these files open. Close it, then try again.
service.files.inUse: Another program has this file open. Close it, then try again.
service.files.needsEntry: This action needs a file or folder inside the project
service.files.notKept: Not one of the session attachments Hive keeps.
service.files.throughLink: Path leads outside the project (through a link)
service.git.tooLarge: File is too large to diff ({kb, number} KB).
service.gitRepo.badName: {kind, select, tag {{hasName, select, yes {{name} isn't a valid tag name.} other {That isn't a valid tag name.}}} other {{hasName, select, yes {{name} isn't a valid branch name.} other {That isn't a valid branch name.}}}}
service.gitRepo.chooseRemote: Choose the remote to push to.
service.gitRepo.detachedPull: HEAD is detached: switch to a branch to pull.
service.gitRepo.detachedPush: HEAD is detached: switch to a branch to push.
service.gitRepo.diverged: {branch} and {upstream} have diverged ({ahead, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}} here, {behind, number} there), so pulling needs a merge or rebase. Do that in a terminal, or ask an agent to.
service.gitRepo.gaveUp: git gave up after {minutes} minutes (no answer from the remote, or a sign-in left open).
service.gitRepo.identityRemoved: Removed this repository's own identity: your global one applies.
service.gitRepo.inWorktree: {branch} is checked out in another worktree ({folder}): a branch can be in only one folder at a time.
service.gitRepo.midOperation: Git is in the middle of a {state}: finish or abort it first.
service.gitRepo.noCommits: The repository has no commits yet: commit something first.
service.gitRepo.noRemotes: This repository has no remotes: add one first.
service.gitRepo.noRemotesFetch: This repository has no remotes to fetch from: add one first.
service.gitRepo.noUpstream: {branch} tracks no remote branch: push it first, or switch to one that does.
service.gitRepo.nothingToPush: The repository has no commits yet: nothing to push.
service.gitRepo.nothingToTag: The repository has no commits yet: nothing to tag.
service.gitRepo.pulled: Pulled {n, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}} from {upstream}.
service.gitRepo.rejected: {to} has commits {branch} hasn't, so the push was refused (Hive never forces a push). Pull first, or merge them in a terminal.
service.gitRepo.tagPushFailed: Tagged {commit} {name}, but couldn't push it to {remote}: {why}
service.hiveVcs.cantList: Git couldn't list the files it tracks in .hive.
service.hiveVcs.cantListWhy: Git couldn't list the files it tracks in .hive ({problem}).
service.hiveVcs.changed: The files git tracks in .hive changed since you were shown them: nothing was untracked. Look again.
service.hiveVcs.noRepo: No git repository holds this project.
service.metrics.badProvider: provider must be a provider id
service.metrics.badRange: from and to must be ISO times, from before to
service.metrics.badRole: role must be agent, assistant, api or viewer
service.metrics.droppedPerProject: Dropped measurements are counted per project, not per role or provider.
service.metrics.notCliContext: Context a CLI adds itself (its own system prompt, tool definitions, files it reads).
service.metrics.notNetwork: Provider network traffic: Hive starts the CLIs; it is not a proxy between them and their providers.
service.metrics.notPerProvider: Agent API requests, tool calls and the tool list aren’t recorded per provider: they are every provider’s.
service.metrics.notSkillReads: Whether a model read a skill: delivered skills are counted, reading one is not observable.
service.metrics.notTokens: Provider tokens per Hive tool or per guidance part: providers report a session’s usage, not what each part of its context cost.
service.metrics.notTransport: HTTP headers and transport: request sizes are the body bytes received, response sizes the JSON body written (an aborted reply may not all have been sent).
service.metrics.sharedNumbers: The skill service and Hive-wide numbers are shared: not per role or provider.

service.providers.retryUnavailable: This update retry is no longer available. Check again, then try Update.

service.providers.stillLookingAll: Hive is still looking for the coding agent CLIs. Try again in a moment.
